comparison.objective: Place an apple left of a bowl and an orange right of it, not in the bowl; candidate breaks and recovers metal tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pick-and-place with relational placement versus coaxial tool use, controlled impact, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Both fruits beside the bowl in the designated relations and arms returned home versus four fractures, no damage, and all fragments in a tray.
comparison.reason: Only generic grasping is shared; the manipulation mechanism and success state differ materially. Exact spatial tolerances are not stated.
